mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_log (wallet_id, pet_id, action_type, target_type, target_id, title, description) VALUES (#{walletId}, #{petId}, #{actionType}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{title}, #{description})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM activity_log WHERE wallet_id = #{walletId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT al.* FROM activity_log al JOIN wallet w ON w.wallet_id = al.wallet_id WHERE w.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY al.created_at DESC
